notes.title: Update 1.32
notes.content:
Updated animations on spiders and heroes!
Updated health and damage values on most creatures.
Main menu and in-game texture optimization to ensure everybody can enjoy this game.
New hidden doors and destructible walls are available.
Improved achievement calculations.

notes.title: Hotfix 3.08
notes.content: Some player has experienced a weird when they were unable to control the characters. This hotfix should fix the issue, however please let me know if you experience any problem via facebook group and It will be fixed hopefully within 24 hours. The regular update is on the way, please stay tuned.

notes.title: Hotfix 3.03 - invite friends
notes.content:
Multiple people reported that they are unable to see online games which are hosted by their steam friends. This is most likely a problem locally, however I added a button ( which design still in progress ) to open a menu with all your stream friends. You will able to see all your friend, however you can send invite to the ones who has the game. I displayed the offline friends also to ensure nobody will be confused and think it is broken.  The friend can accept the invite via the chat window, which should just join your session and you can start to play. 

I hope it helps, however since the search problem mostly caused by a firewall block or antivirus software It might not fix the problem for everybody, but will make the hosting easier. 

In the future there will be a refresh button also, however steam refuse to refresh the friend list automatically, a plugin needs to be written which will cause a bit delay. Expect the fully functioning system within 3 days.

notes.title: Patch 2.08
notes.content:
The changes are the following in the update 2.08:

Heroes:


 Death Knight armor change: 16 -> 15
 Death Knight resist change : 6 -> 7
 Wizard armor change: 10 -> 9
 Rogue armor change: 13 -> 12 
 Rogue resist change: 9 -> 8


Enemy:

 Dark elf (boss) skill radius has been reduced
 Bloodfang spider ( boss ) skill accuracy has been reduced
 Plant abominations dodge rating has been reduced by 2%
 Pyromancer damage change (AOE) now deals fire damage
 


New hero released : Druid

 Druid is a supportive hero, which has primarily utility spells. 



Main menu has been reworked, now it has a nice translucency effect and the wording is consistent now. Also the menu performance has been optimized. 

Future improvements which are expected next week part of the regular weekly update:


 Rework the druid animation and make all unit animation to play at a consistent 30 Frame/second. 
 Adding new sound effects
 Make the game auto balance logic more sensitive, so nobody will stuck
 Adding a new enemy
 Adding a new achievement
 Credits menu improvement. 


Thank you for being awesome!

notes.title: Patch note 1.31
notes.content:
This patch (1.31) contains only back end replication optimization for multiplayer game mode, which will reduce the latency for the client and fix the animation issue, where the character stuck in an attack loop. Network prediction also implemented on this patch.

Due technical problems with the network prediction, the testing process took longer than expected, so unfortunately the new character release will be delayed. Expected release day for the new main menu design and the new character is 8th of February. 

Thanks for being awesome!

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
The changes are the following in the update 1.12: 

 Widget changes : 

 Game settings has been renamed to options
 Text is consistent across the board - capitalization and naming
  Background has been unified
 You will be able to see which settings is on currently - highlight has been added to the active one
 Gamma setting starts at 2.2 by default instead of 1 and now correctly shows it
 Gamma setting now scales between 0.5 and 5 instead of 1-5 range
 Tool tip has been added to the game settings for clarification
 Tool tip has been added to the target widget for clarification
 Menu position has been fixed on all resolution
 The loading screen has been modified, now it does not show the white border
 In game menu now spawn the sub-menu in the right spot.
 Escape now toggles the menu, so you can close it with this hotkey


 Camera

 Camera speed has been adjusted
 Camera hotkeys ( Q and E ) now continuously rotate the camera - and the speed has been adjusted


 Miscellaneous 

 The enemy positioning has been improved
 Now the enemy is selected if your cursor overlaps with the enemy ( with delay to ensure you won`t select enemy accidentally ) 
 If there is no enemy on the map your movement points will refresh ( non aggressive enemy such us barrel will not prevent the refreshing ) 
 Skills cannot be used while you are not the active player
 On co-operative mode the second player has different dialog
 On game over the end screen will pop up once


Also I want to apologize for a game braking bug. This bug was removed all your widget and you were not able to pass the turn, move or do anything else. 

  Future improvements which are expected next week part of the regular weekly update:


 Icon rework
 Character and creature voice update
 Weapon sound and other SFX update
 Volume balance changes
 Various widget optimization


  Plans for this month:

 New character release
 New enemy release
 New campaign map
 New steam achievements


Thank you for being awesome!
